answer.rationale: Run a small, guarded activation-messaging test for price-sensitive SMB accounts. In-product messaging previously improved week-one engagement by 11%, activation by 6%, and 30-day retention by 1%, supporting sustainable value. Avoid responding with broad promotional pricing: although the targeted discount increased signups by 31% and qualified revenue by 18%, retention fell 12%, creating substantial downstream value risk and poor long-term economics.
